notes: A daily nudge (v2.5): Data & settings gains a Daily reminder switch - off by default, and only shown in the installed app, because a browser tab cannot wake up at 20:00. Turn it on and Android schedules one local notification a day at 20:00 quoting how many words are due today (today's notice is cleared the moment you open the app); the alarm re-arms itself every night and after a reboot. Nothing is asked at install: the notification permission is requested the first time you switch the reminder on, and a refusal flips the switch back off instead of promising a reminder that would never arrive. Where the system withholds exact alarms (Android 13+), the reminder falls back to an inexact alarm rather than dropping silently.
